title: This is the biggest box of junk I have ever seen!
text:
First off, I tried to cancel this box after the first month but their cancellation system has a dark pattern where you think you cancelled but you didn't. As a result I have 2 months of boxes, so I know being total trash wasn't a one time thing.

Basically it's all self care/body care products and nothing that's actually therapeutic (description says "practical joy boosting activities). I actually have opened both boxes with a therapist friend and she was appalled. Everything has the vibe of being from the Marshall's weird body care aisle, or maybe they just buy up stock of discontinued items. My favorite thing was the "toilet paper moisturizer" that came in the spring box, but it's a close tie with the random spoon that was in the Feb/Valentine's/"love" box. The only therapeutic aspect is that we laughed until we cried both times, and that felt nice.

This month (the spring box) was "packed" with laundry detergent, reusable paper towels, the butt wipe stuff, nail polish, and some heavily scented body care products (definitely don't get this box if you have sensitive skin). The message seems to be that I need to clean it up. I honestly can't remember what was in last month's because I literally threw the whole thing in the trash--even the spoon that read "I love to you to the spoon and back." Love theme, get it. Don't you feel happier?!
label: negative
